User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The flaw exists within the handling of Lotus wk1 files. It is possible to trigger a buffer overflow when handling malformed data within a Lotus wk1 file. title: Hewlett-Packard KeyView IDOL Lotus Parsing Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard KeyView IDOL. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The flaw exists within the handling of Lotus wk1 files. It is possible to trigger a buffer overflow when handling malformed data within a Lotus wk1 file. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the process.
